INSERT INTO TBL_MOVE_REQUEST (REQUEST_ID, MEMBER_ID, HOUSE_TYPE, PACK_TYPE, MOVE_DATE, PREFER_TIME, MOVE_TIME, FROM_ADDRESS, FROM_DETAIL, FROM_ZIPCODE, TO_ADDRESS, TO_DETAIL, TO_ZIPCODE, AI_CBM, AI_EST_AMOUNT, AI_EST_MIN, AI_EST_MAX, AI_ANALYSIS_SEC, AI_CONFIDENCE, REQUESTED_AT) VALUES (#{requestId}, #{memberId}, #{houseType}, #{packType}, #{moveDate,jdbcType=DATE}, #{preferTime,jdbcType=CHAR}, #{moveTime,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{fromAddress}, #{fromDetail,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{fromZipcode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{toAddress}, #{toDetail,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{toZipcode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{aiCbm,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{aiEstAmount,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{aiEstMin,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{aiEstMax,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{aiAnalysisSec,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{aiConfidence,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, SYSDATE)

INSERT INTO TBL_REQUEST_ITEM (RE_ITEM_ID, REQUEST_ID, CATEGORY, ITEM_NAME, ITEM_SIZE, QUANTITY, VOLUME, CONFIDENCE, NEEDS_REVIEW, SOURCE) VALUES (SEQ_REQUEST_ITEM.NEXTVAL, #{requestId}, #{category,jdbcType=CHAR}, #{itemName}, #{itemSize}, #{quantity}, #{volume}, #{confidence,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{needsReview}, #{source})
INSERT INTO TBL_RE_VIDEO (VIDEO_ID, REQUEST_ID, FILE_NAME, FILE_PATH, UPLOADED_AT) VALUES (SEQ_RE_VIDEO.NEXTVAL, #{requestId}, #{fileName}, #{filePath}, SYSDATE)
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM TBL_MOVE_REQUEST WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} ORDER BY REQUESTED_AT DESC, REQUEST_ID DESC

SELECT * FROM (SELECT * FROM TBL_RE_VIDEO WHERE REQUEST_ID = #{requestId} ORDER BY UPLOADED_AT DESC) WHERE ROWNUM = 1

INSERT INTO TBL_RESERVATION (RESERVATION_ID, RESERVATION_NO, REQUEST_ID, STATUS, PAY_STATUS, MOVE_DATE, MOVE_TIME, MOVE_MEMO, APPLIED_AT) VALUES (#{reservationId}, 'RSV-' || TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') || '-' || LPAD(MOD(#{reservationId}, 10000), 4, '0'), #{requestId}, '01', '01', #{moveDate}, #{moveTime,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{moveMemo,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, SYSDATE)
mapper.update: UPDATE TBL_RESERVATION SET STATUS = '01', PAY_STATUS = '01', MOVE_DATE = #{moveDate}, MOVE_TIME = #{moveTime,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, APPLIED_AT = SYSDATE, DEPOSIT_PAID_AT = NULL, CANCELLED_AT = NULL, CANCELLED_BY = NULL WHERE RESERVATION_ID = #{reservationId}
UPDATE TBL_RESERVATION SET MOVE_MEMO = #{memo,jdbcType=VARCHAR} WHERE RESERVATION_ID = #{reservationId}
UPDATE TBL_RESERVATION SET PAY_STATUS = '02', DEPOSIT_PAID_AT = SYSDATE WHERE RESERVATION_ID = #{reservationId} AND STATUS != '03'
mapper.sql: SELECT v.RESERVATION_ID, v.RESERVATION_NO, v.STATUS, v.PAY_STATUS, v.MOVE_DATE, v.MOVE_TIME, v.MOVE_MEMO, v.APPLIED_AT, v.DEPOSIT_PAID_AT, r.REQUEST_ID, m.MEMBER_ID, m.MEMBER_NAME, m.PHONE, r.HOUSE_TYPE, r.PACK_TYPE, r.FROM_ADDRESS, r.FROM_DETAIL, r.TO_ADDRESS, r.TO_DETAIL, q.QUOTE_ID, q.QUOTE_NO, q.TOTAL_AMOUNT, q.DEPOSIT_AMOUNT, q.VOLUME_TON, CASE WHEN q.FROM_LADDER_USE = 'Y' OR q.TO_LADDER_USE = 'Y' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS LADDER_USE, CASE WHEN q.FROM_ELEVATOR_USE = 'Y' OR q.TO_ELEVATOR_USE = 'Y' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS ELEVATOR_USE FROM TBL_RESERVATION v JOIN TBL_MOVE_REQUEST r ON r.REQUEST_ID = v.REQUEST_ID JOIN TBL_MEMBER m ON m.MEMBER_ID = r.MEMBER_ID LEFT JOIN TBL_QUOTE q ON q.REQUEST_ID = r.REQUEST_ID
